artworks.title: Bull Attacked by Dogs
artworks.description: The image shows a bull surrounded by several dogs. One dog appears airborne near the bull, while others are around it. The bull has an injury on its back. In the background, two figures are watching the scene. The drawing portrays a dynamic and dramatic interaction between the animals with expressive lines conveying movement and tension.

artworks.title: Dans un parc
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed and intricate etching depicting a view from eye-level. In the distance, an ancient or medieval stone archway can be seen partially hidden by dense foliage. The horizon is suggested by the meeting point of trees and architectural elements against the sky. The artwork uses a limited color palette of sepia and black, emphasizing texture through fine lines. The foreground consists of lush vegetation, including trees with bare branches creating a natural frame around the scene across the archway.

artworks.title: Interior of a Military Chamber
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a military barracks interior scene. The room is filled with various activities and items. Rifles are lined against the wall to the left, and shelves hold pots, bottles, and bags. Characters are involved in different actions, contributing to a busy atmosphere. In the center, figures are around a person in bed, while others are examining materials or grooming. The drawing portrays the camaraderie and daily life in a communal living space, offering a glimpse into military life. The shading and detailing add depth to the illustration.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The image features a detailed baroque-style frame surrounding a text. An ornate collection of musical instruments and tools are integrated into the top and bottom of the frame. The color palette consists of various shades of brown, giving an antique feel. The central text is flanked by elaborate garlands featuring instruments like a violin, a lute, and tools at the upper corners. The lower part of the image shows a pastoral scene with people and a building, providing a balanced layout.

artworks.title: Le dragon qui se void dans le jardin de Ruel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decoration and garden scene. The upper section of the drawing features an intricate arrangement of gemstones or jewels, depicted with a high level of detail, showcasing faceted surfaces and round, polished beads. This collection of jewels is surrounded by a wreath of leaves and ribbons. Below the jewel arrangement, there is a landscape view of a garden. In this section, there is a fountain at the center, surrounded by trees and pathways. The garden scene seems to represent a formal garden layout typical of grand estates, characterized by neatly arranged trees and a symmetrically structured water feature. The structure of this scene suggests a depiction of elegance and wealth.

artworks.title: Fontaines qui se voyent a Ruel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three ornate pendants surrounded by a floral border with a landscape scene below. The central image features three intricately designed pendants, each hanging from ribbons and set within a lavish arrangement of flowers. The top pendant is shaped like a flower, the pendant on the right has a circular design, and the bottom pendant resembles a clock face with Roman numerals. Surrounding the pendants is a border of various flowers. Below this image is a scene of a garden with fountains, trees, pathways, and tiny human figures.

artworks.title: Rome
artworks.description: The image has two sections. The upper section features ornamental designs with floral arrangements, ribbons, and birds. The lower section shows a cityscape labeled "Rome" with iconic architectural features. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: Saint Denis en France
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative arrangement with architectural and floral motifs. The central feature is an elaborate depiction of large, symmetrical bows and ornaments, surrounded by intricate floral and leafy designs. At the top center of the arrangement, an anthropomorphic face is visible, flanked by stylized floral patterns on each side. Below the decorative arrangement, there is a smaller, detailed landscape scene labeled "Sainct Denis en France," showing a cityscape with a prominent church or cathedral structure. The entire composition is meticulously detailed, showcasing a high level of craftsmanship in its depiction of both the ornate decorations and the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Paris
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring an ornate design at the top with intricate frames and floral motifs. The frames are suspended within a circular floral wreath. The etching technique provides detailed textures and patterns. Below this is a cityscape labeled "PARIS" with a ribbon banner. The skyline shows spires, rooftops, and small figures typical of a city setting in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: La perspective de l'englise Nostre Dame de Paris
artworks.description: The image features a detailed engraving. The top half shows a portrait within an oval garland of flowers and baubles. The person has long, curly hair and ornate clothing. Surrounding the portrait are decorative elements like flowers and a bow. The bottom half depicts an architectural scene of Notre Dame de Paris with small figures in a square. Other buildings surround the central structure in a bustling urban environment. The composition is in monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: Le chasteau de Ruel
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate floral wreath and architectural scene. There is a central composition featuring a wreath made of flowers and leaves. Surrounding the wreath are four rows of intricate patterns resembling ornamental jewelry designs. Below the wreath is a detailed depiction of a grand building set within a landscaped garden labeled "Le Chasteau de Ruel." The drawing is done in detailed line work, creating an elegant depiction.

artworks.title: La chasse royalle
artworks.description: The image displays a collection of ornate jewelry pieces. It includes a large cross adorned with diamonds and gemstones, surrounded by smaller intricate pieces and floral arrangements. The color palette is monochrome with shades of brown and beige, reflecting the etching style. Detailed floral garlands are draped at the top, tied with ribbons, cascading downwards. Smaller pendants are suspended in the center. Below the jewelry and flowers, there is a narrow strip depicting a pastoral landscape scene with buildings in the distance and figures near a body of water.

artworks.title: Perspective de Ruel
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an elaborate decorative arrangement above a scene of a garden and architectural structure. The upper section includes floral arrangements, tassels, and ornate decorations. Two squirrels are pictured on either side, and a garland or wreath forms an arch at the center. Below, there is an inset image of formal gardens leading to an ornate building structure. The lower portion captures people walking and standing in the garden.

artworks.title: La veue du pont de Rouen
artworks.description: The image showcases a dual composition divided into two sections. The upper section features an intricate ornamental design with symmetrical clusters resembling beaded jewelry, encircled by a garland of flowers and leaves. Below, there is a horizontal cityscape scene, potentially depicting the Pont de Rouen based on the inscription. The horizon line divides the lower section, showing a river, a stone bridge, a cityscape with a cathedral, and additional architecture. The entire composition is rendered in fine lines and cross-hatching with a monochromatic color palette, highlighting detailed craftsmanship.

artworks.title: La veue du Pont Neuf; Louis XIV Roy de Franceet de Navarre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wreath surrounding a portrait with a scene of a bridge below. The wreath is circular and detailed with leaves and flowers. In the center, there is a rectangular frame with a portrait. Below the wreath and portrait, the scene shows a river with a multi-arched stone bridge crossing it, known as the Pont Neuf, with buildings on the riverbanks. The drawing emphasizes a balance between natural and constructed elements through intricate details and fine lines.

artworks.title: Death of Maximilian at Queretaro (L'executionde Maximilien)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures in a scene. The painting shows a situation where a line of uniformed figures interacts with three standing figures in another group. The uniforms have dark tones and the painting uses black and white. The figures are arranged dynamically, conveying tension. The background is dark, contrasting with the figures in lighter clothing. The style is reminiscent of Édouard Manet, known for capturing poignant and historical moments realistically.

artworks.title: Polichinelle
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking with a staff, wearing an elaborate outfit and distinct facial features. The person has a tricorn hat, a pink jacket with lace detailing, a white cravat, multi-colored trousers, and red shoes with white pom-poms. Their facial features include a prominent nose, furrowed brow, and curly grey hair. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Madonna on a Crescent
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated female figure holding a child, both surrounded by radiating lines. The female figure is positioned centrally, looking down at the child in her arms. She has long hair and wears a crown, a flowing gown, and holds a scepter. The child has curly hair and is looking up, clutching the adult figure. The background consists of intricate lines creating a halo effect. There are initials and a small sword in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec
artworks.description: The image shows a partial profile view of a person in a bowler hat with a prominent nose, mustache, and short beard. They are wearing a coat with a high collar, and the background is textured. The artwork is signed with the initials "C.M" and numbered "No. 44" at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Christophe de Thou
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man showing him from the chest up. He is positioned facing the viewer, with a calm expression on his face. The individual has a high forehead, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a defined chin. His hair is short and neatly arranged, and he wears a cap. He is dressed in a fur-trimmed coat over a garment with a high, pleated collar. The coat's texture is detailed, suggesting sophistication. Around him is an oval frame with text in Latin characters. The background is a textured surface within the oval frame.

artworks.title: The Bellman
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 19 x 25.1 cm (7 1/2 x 9 7/8 in.)
sheet: 23 x 36 cm (9 1/16 x 14 3/16 in.)
overall (mat): 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a village scene with hills in the background and a setting or rising sun partially obscured by a tree. A path leads to the village, lined with a house and a figure walking, while cows rest to the right. In the distance, more village buildings with thatched roofs and smoking chimneys are visible. The artwork features detailed and heavily etched brushstrokes, creating depth and texture in the foliage and architecture. The color scheme consists of rich browns and blacks, with white accents for light.

artworks.title: The Rising Moon, or An English Pastoral
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with fields and haystacks, a sun behind hills, trees, and two distant figures. The etching's fine and detailed brushstrokes capture textures. The color palette is limited to brown and gray, creating a monochromatic atmosphere. The composition evokes tranquility in the countryside.

artworks.title: The Rising Moon, or An English Pastoral
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with sheep grazing on a hillside. The sun is setting in the upper portion of the image, casting a soft glow over the landscape. The artwork shows detailed textures in the sheep's wool, trees, and farmhouses. The color scheme is mainly black, gray, and white. Tall trees are visible in the distance, and a person is seen standing among the sheep.

artworks.title: Woman with a Harp
artworks.description: The image depicts a partially nude figure shown seated in a relaxed position with legs extended. The person holds a harp in one hand, positioned across the lap. Their facial features are distinct, with a round face, delicate eyes, and a soft gaze. The hair is curly and styled in an intricate updo. The person's other arm rests on their bent leg, and they are surrounded by a rich fabric. Next to the seated figure, there is a stringed instrument leaning against a scroll-like architectural feature. The background consists of detailed textural elements that suggest a carefully designed setting, with circular shapes enclosing the scene.
